name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Confetti animations are best used to delight your users when something special happens.

props.name: ref
props.description: Exposes { fire(options?) } to fire bursts imperatively.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the canvas. Size it yourself, e.g. absolute inset-0 size-full. Other canvas props (e.g. onMouseEnter) are forwarded too.

props.name: options
props.description: Default options for every burst (particleCount, angle, spread, startVelocity, decay, gravity, drift, flat, ticks, origin, colors, shapes, scalar, zIndex).

props.name: manualstart
props.description: Don't fire a burst on mount.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered after the canvas. Children can call useConfetti() to get { fire }.

props.name: fire
props.description: Fires a burst on the canvas; per-call options override the options prop. Available on the ref and from useConfetti().

props.name: options
props.description: Burst options. The origin is always the centre of the button.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the burst. Call event.preventDefault() to skip the confetti.
